name: 31-caching-at-depth-claude
description: cachingAtDepthForClaude (prompt-converters.js:985-1011) at depth 1 with a 1h TTL, on an array that opens with two system turns. `cachingAtDepth` is not 0 here on purpose: the walk starts at the last turn and no trailing assistant turn exists, so the first iteration sets `passedThePrefill` and counts depth 0 -- the assistant is skipped by the *role switch*, not by the prefill guard, and depth 0 is past the two breakpoints. Depth 1 is the first user turn (the second system turn shares the previous role and is skipped for counting), and it receives the `cache_control` object on the *last* part of its content. The count continues to depth 3, which is past `cachingAtDepth + 2`, so nothing else is stamped.
